# AGENTS.md

Repository instructions for AI coding agents. Keep this file short, concrete, and tied to commands that actually work in this
repo. If a fact here conflicts with source files or CI config, trust the source file and update this guide.

## Project Snapshot

Memos is a self-hosted note-taking app.

- Backend: Go 1.26.2, Echo v5, Connect RPC, gRPC-Gateway, Protocol Buffers.
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript 6, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, React Query v5.
- Storage: SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL.
- Generated API outputs: `proto/gen/` for Go/OpenAPI, `web/src/types/proto/` for TypeScript.

## Working Rules

- Read relevant code before editing; prefer local patterns over new abstractions.
- Keep diffs scoped. Do not do repo-wide cleanup, dependency churn, or generated-file rewrites unless the task requires it.
- Do not hand-edit generated proto outputs. Change `.proto` files, then run `buf generate`.
- Add migrations for all database drivers when schema changes, and update each driver's `LATEST.sql`.
- Add public API endpoints to `server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go`.
- Ask before adding heavy dependencies, changing auth/token behavior, or altering Docker/release workflows.

## Commands

Run from the repository root unless a command starts with `cd`.

```bash
# Backend
go run ./cmd/memos --port 8081    # Start backend dev server
go test ./...                      # Run all Go tests
go test -v ./store/...             # Store tests, including DB drivers via TestContainers
go test -v -race ./server/...      # Server tests with race detector
go test -v -race ./internal/...    # Internal package tests with race detector
go test -v -run TestFoo ./pkg/...  # Run matching Go tests
go mod tidy -go=1.26.2             # Match CI tidy check
golangci-lint run                  # Go lint, config: .golangci.yaml
golangci-lint run --fix            # Auto-fix lint, including goimports

# Frontend
cd web && pnpm install             # Install dependencies
cd web && pnpm dev                 # Dev server on :3001, proxying API to :8081
cd web && pnpm lint                # Type check + Biome lint
cd web && pnpm test                # Vitest unit tests
cd web && pnpm build               # Production build
cd web && pnpm release             # Build SPA into server/router/frontend/dist

# Protocol Buffers
cd proto && buf generate           # Regenerate Go + TypeScript + OpenAPI
cd proto && buf lint               # Lint proto files
cd proto && buf format -w          # Format proto files
```

## Code Map

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `cmd/memos/main.go` | Cobra/Viper CLI setup and server startup |
| `server/server.go` | Echo HTTP server and background runner wiring |
| `server/auth/` | JWT access tokens, refresh tokens, PAT handling |
| `server/router/api/v1/` | Connect/gRPC-Gateway services, ACL config, SSE hub |
| `server/router/frontend/` | Static SPA serving |
| `server/router/fileserver/` | Native HTTP file serving, thumbnails, range requests |
| `server/runner/` | Background memo processing and S3 presign refresh |
| `store/` | Store facade, cache, migrations, driver interface |
| `store/db/{sqlite,mysql,postgres}/` | Database-specific drivers and SQL |
| `proto/api/v1/` | Public API service definitions |
| `proto/store/` | Internal storage proto messages |
| `internal/` | App-private packages: scheduler, cron, email, CEL filter, markdown, idp, S3 |
| `web/src/connect.ts` | Connect RPC clients, auth interceptor, access-token refresh |
| `web/src/auth-state.ts` | Token storage and BroadcastChannel cross-tab sync |
| `web/src/hooks/` | React Query hooks for server state |
| `web/src/contexts/` | React context for client/UI state |
| `web/src/components/` | Radix/Tailwind UI components and feature components |
| `web/src/themes/` | CSS themes using OKLch color tokens |

FROM --platform=$BUILDPLATFORM golang:1.26.2-alpine AS backend
WORKDIR /backend-build

# Install build dependencies
RUN apk add --no-cache git ca-certificates

# Copy go mod files and download dependencies (cached layer)
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    go mod download

# Copy source code (use .dockerignore to exclude unnecessary files)
COPY . .

# Please build frontend first, so that the static files are available.
# Refer to `pnpm release` in package.json for the build command.
ARG TARGETOS TARGETARCH VERSION=dev COMMIT=unknown
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/go/pkg/mod \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/go-build \
    CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=$TARGETOS GOARCH=$TARGETARCH \
    go build \
      -trimpath \
      -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/usememos/memos/internal/version.Version=${VERSION} -X github.com/usememos/memos/internal/version.Commit=${COMMIT} -extldflags '-static'" \
      -tags netgo,osusergo \
      -o memos \
      ./cmd/memos

# Use minimal Alpine with security updates
FROM alpine:3.21 AS monolithic

# Install runtime dependencies and create non-root user in single layer
RUN apk add --no-cache tzdata ca-certificates su-exec && \
    addgroup -g 10001 -S nonroot && \
    adduser -u 10001 -S -G nonroot -h /var/opt/memos nonroot && \
    mkdir -p /var/opt/memos /usr/local/memos && \
    chown -R nonroot:nonroot /var/opt/memos

# Copy binary and entrypoint to /usr/local/memos
COPY --from=backend /backend-build/memos /usr/local/memos/memos
COPY --from=backend --chmod=755 /backend-build/scripts/entrypoint.sh /usr/local/memos/entrypoint.sh

# Run as root to fix permissions, entrypoint will drop to nonroot
USER root

# Set working directory to the writable volume
WORKDIR /var/opt/memos

# Data directory
VOLUME /var/opt/memos

ENV TZ="UTC" \
    MEMOS_PORT="5230"

EXPOSE 5230

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/memos/entrypoint.sh", "/usr/local/memos/memos"]

#!/usr/bin/env sh

# Fix ownership of the data directory (e.g. for users upgrading from older
# versions where files were created as root) and drop to a non-root user.
MEMOS_UID=${MEMOS_UID:-10001}
MEMOS_GID=${MEMOS_GID:-10001}
DATA_DIR="/var/opt/memos"

# MEMOS_ENTRYPOINT_SWITCHED marks that the privilege drop below has already run.
# su-exec preserves the environment, so the marker survives the re-exec. Without
# it, a target of UID 0 (e.g. MEMOS_UID=0, common under rootless Docker) would
# stay root after su-exec, re-enter this block, and loop forever.
if [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] && [ -z "${MEMOS_ENTRYPOINT_SWITCHED:-}" ]; then
    # Started as root: fix permissions, then re-exec as the target user.
    if [ -d "$DATA_DIR" ]; then
        chown -R "$MEMOS_UID:$MEMOS_GID" "$DATA_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    echo "memos: starting as UID:GID ${MEMOS_UID}:${MEMOS_GID}"
    export MEMOS_ENTRYPOINT_SWITCHED=1
    exec su-exec "$MEMOS_UID:$MEMOS_GID" "$0" "$@"
fi
unset MEMOS_ENTRYPOINT_SWITCHED

file_env() {
   var="$1"
   fileVar="${var}_FILE"

   val_var="$(printenv "$var")"
   val_fileVar="$(printenv "$fileVar")"

   if [ -n "$val_var" ] && [ -n "$val_fileVar" ]; then
      echo "error: both $var and $fileVar are set (but are exclusive)" >&2
      exit 1
   fi

   if [ -n "$val_var" ]; then
      val="$val_var"
   elif [ -n "$val_fileVar" ]; then
      if [ ! -r "$val_fileVar" ]; then
         echo "error: file '$val_fileVar' does not exist or is not readable" >&2
         exit 1
      fi
      val="$(cat "$val_fileVar")"
   fi

   export "$var"="$val"
   unset "$fileVar"
}

## Server entry and startup chain

There is **one server binary**: `cmd/memos/main.go`. It migrates the DB, loads config, builds the server, calls `s.Start(ctx)`, then blocks on context cancel.

```76:90:cmd/memos/main.go
			s, err := server.NewServer(ctx, instanceProfile, storeInstance)
			// ...
			if err := s.Start(ctx); err != nil {
```

Docker runs the same binary: `scripts/Dockerfile` builds `./cmd/memos`; `scripts/entrypoint.sh` execs `/usr/local/memos/memos`. `web/package.json` only has frontend build/dev scripts (`dev`, `build`, `release`); the Go server embeds the built SPA — no separate Node process at runtime.

---

## Runners the server actually starts

### Explicit background runners (`startBackgroundRunners`)

**S3 presign runner (immediate `RunOnce`)** — triggered once at startup, before the loop (`server/server.go:163`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43-45`).

**S3 presign runner (continuous loop)** — triggered by a **12-hour `time.Ticker`** in a goroutine started from `Server.Start()` → `startBackgroundRunners()` (`server/server.go:153-171`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-40`). Also runs immediately once on startup (see above).

That is the **only** runner registered in `startBackgroundRunners`. Shutdown cancels it via `backgroundRunnerCancels` and waits on `backgroundRunnerWG` (`server/server.go:140-143`, `176-200`).

### HTTP server goroutine

**Echo HTTP server** — triggered by `Server.Start()` calling `httpServer.Serve(listener)` in a goroutine (`server/server.go:122-128`). Not a scheduled job; it serves requests until shutdown.

### Package-`init()` worker pools (start when the process loads)

**Webhook async dispatch workers (4 goroutines)** — triggered by `webhook.PostAsync()` enqueueing to a buffered channel; workers started in `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-54`). Enqueued from memo webhook handlers on create/update/delete/comment (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:43,71`), which are called from memo API side effects (`memo_service.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`, `memo_update_helpers.go`).

**Email async send workers (2 goroutines)** — triggered by `email.SendAsync()` enqueue; workers started in `init()` (`internal/email/email.go:14-35`). Default sender in `notification.NewEmailDispatcher` is `email.SendAsync` (`server/notification/email.go:28-30,95`). Invoked when inbox notifications are created (`server/router/api/v1/notification_email.go:16-22`), e.g. memo comments (`memo_service_comments.go:101`) and mentions (`memo_mention_helpers.go:124`).

### Store cache cleanup loops (started with `store.New`, before server)

**Instance-setting cache cleanup** — triggered by **5-minute ticker** (`CleanupInterval`) started in `cache.New()` (`store/store.go:51`, `store/cache/cache.go:76-84,199-214`).

**User cache cleanup** — same 5-minute ticker (`store/store.go:52`, `store/cache/cache.go:83`).

**User-setting cache cleanup** — same 5-minute ticker (`store/store.go:53`, `store/cache/cache.go:83`).

All three are stopped on `Store.Close()` during server shutdown (`store/store.go:72-76`).

### Other goroutines (not scheduled runners, but background work)

**Graceful shutdown handler** — triggered by **SIGINT/SIGTERM** in `main` (`cmd/memos/main.go:83-103`).

**PAT last-used timestamp updater** — triggered **per PAT-authenticated request** via one-off goroutine (`server/auth/authenticator.go:179-184`, called at `:220`).

**SSE connection heartbeat** — triggered **per connected SSE client** by a **30-second ticker** in the request handler (`server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go:16-17,63-65`). The hub itself has no background loop (`sse_hub.go`).

---

## One-line summary (runner — trigger)

- **S3 presign runner (startup pass)** — immediate `RunOnce` at server start (`server/server.go:163`)
- **S3 presign runner (loop)** — 12-hour `time.Ticker` + cancel on shutdown (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-40`, `server/server.go:166-171`)
- **Echo HTTP server** — `Server.Start()` → `httpServer.Serve` goroutine (`server/server.go:124-128`)
- **Webhook async workers (×4)** — package `init()`; work from `webhook.PostAsync()` on memo webhook events (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`, `memo_service_webhooks.go:43,71`)
- **Email async workers (×2)** — package `init()`; work from `email.SendAsync()` on inbox email notifications (`internal/email/email.go:16-35`, `notification/email.go:95`)
- **Store cache cleanup (×3)** — `store.New()` → 5-minute ticker per cache (`store/store.go:51-53`, `store/cache/cache.go:199-214`)
- **Shutdown signal handler** — SIGINT/SIGTERM in `main` (`cmd/memos/main.go:99-103`)
- **PAT usage recorder** — one-off goroutine per PAT auth (`server/auth/authenticator.go:179-184`)
- **SSE heartbeat** — per-client 30s ticker during `/api/v1/sse` connection (`sse_handler.go:16-17,63-65`)

---

## Unused or not-started scheduling infrastructure

**`internal/scheduler/` (cron scheduler)** — full cron-based job scheduler with `Register`, `Start`, `Stop`, middleware, and cron parsing (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`). It is **never imported or started** by server or `cmd/memos`; only referenced in its own tests and `example_test.go`. No `scheduler.New()` / `scheduler.Start()` anywhere outside `internal/scheduler/`.

**`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`** — defines a batch `Runner.RunOnce()` that rebuilds all memo payloads, but **`memopayload.NewRunner` / `RunOnce` are never called** at startup or elsewhere. Only the synchronous helper `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` is used inline on memo create/update (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`). AGENTS.md lists `server/runner/` as “Background memo processing and S3 presign refresh,” but only S3 presign is actually wired as a background runner.

**No cron, job queue, or external worker process** — no Redis/RabbitMQ/sidekiq-style queue; async work is in-process channel + goroutine pools only.

**GitHub Actions cron** (`.github/workflows/stale.yml`) closes stale issues on an 8-hour schedule — CI only, not part of the Memos server process.

The focus is on identifying which background runners the server starts and what triggers their scheduling.

The server starts four webhook workers and two email workers via package initialization. It also starts three cache cleanup loops via store.New. The S3 presign runner uses a 12-hour time.Ticker. The HTTP server goroutine is treated as a background worker.

The S3 presign runner also runs once immediately at server startup. Webhook workers consume a channel queue fed by `webhook.PostAsync()` from memo webhook handlers. Email workers consume a channel queue fed by `email.SendAsync()` through the notification email dispatcher. Cache cleanup loops tick every five minutes per cache. No scheduling infrastructure appears unused.

The internal scheduler package is never instantiated outside tests. The memo payload runner exists but is never started; its rebuild helper is called synchronously in the memo API. Shutdown signal handling, SSE heartbeats, and PAT recorders are not background workers started at server startup.

The HTTP server is excluded from the runner list because the codebase reserves that term for the `server/runner/` package. The answer will list only named runners and other background worker pools.

q28.
S3 presign runner (startup pass) — immediate `RunOnce` in `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)
S3 presign runner (loop) — 12-hour `time.Ticker` in `s3presign.Runner.Run`, started as a goroutine from `startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go`, `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)
Webhook async workers (×4) — package `init()` goroutines; work arrives via `webhook.PostAsync` when memo webhooks fire (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`)
Email async workers (×2) — package `init()` goroutines; work arrives via `email.SendAsync` from inbox email notifications (`internal/email/email.go`, `server/notification/email.go`)
Instance-setting cache cleanup — 5-minute `CleanupInterval` ticker started in `cache.New` during `store.New` in `cmd/memos/main.go` (`store/store.go`, `store/cache/cache.go`)
User cache cleanup — same 5-minute ticker per cache (`store/store.go`, `store/cache/cache.go`)
User-setting cache cleanup — same 5-minute ticker per cache (`store/store.go`, `store/cache/cache.go`)

Unused scheduling infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` provides a cron-based job scheduler (`Register`, `Start`, `Stop`) but is never imported or started outside its own tests/docs (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`). `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` defines a batch `Runner.RunOnce`, but the server never calls `memopayload.NewRunner` or starts it; only the synchronous helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is used on memo create/update (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`).
